The cell measurably depletes the local nutrient it senses before diffusion partially
resupplies it — environmental modification as a direct spatial-metabolic consequence, not a scripted

net field-wide sink) is cadence-robust, and the field-wide net-consumption number (~32 units)

INSTANTANEOUS local-footprint figures quoted here — the 0.94 endpoint, the ~18% peak-to-trough
and ~6%-from-initial depths — are NOT cadence-converged — the local footprint concentration is
a single-tick snapshot over a stochastically-shifting CPM footprint (whose fixed mcs_per_update
is not interval-scaled), and it drifts ~16% between coupling cadence 0.25 and 0.5. These local
depths are therefore APPROXIMATE, cadence-1 readings, not converged quantities; the load-bearing
claim (local depletion happens and is sharply local) stands.

nodes.label: INTERFACE SURROGATE CALIBRATION — a tuned Michaelis-Menten twin reproduces th...
nodes.statement:
INTERFACE SURROGATE CALIBRATION — a tuned Michaelis-Menten twin reproduces the
flagship's cell↔field interface observables, this investigation's test of the paper's
substitutability idea at the level of surrogate calibration. The paper (§2 / §Cellular interface)
argues that "this substitutability is not only a
software convenience. It allows the interface itself to become the object of comparison:
different mechanisms may realize the same externally observable relation", and that "different
internal organizations may sometimes be represented through the same coarse-grained interface
when they preserve the interaction variables relevant to that description." Here that idea is
put to a first test: the flagship cell's INTERNAL metabolism is swapped from constraint-based
dynamic-FBA (cobra e_coli_core, O2-capped) to a lumped, cobra-free Michaelis–Menten / Monod metabolism
(`single-cell-in-a-field-mm`, `mechanism: mm`) behind the BYTE-IDENTICAL `CpmCellField` ports,
and the interface-level observables are compared head-to-head. Confirmed: over 20 ticks the tuned
MM twin reproduces the coarse-grained cell↔field interface — final
biomass dFBA 0.370 vs MM 0.342 (7.5%), CPM volume 110 vs 99 px (10%), total acetate secreted
47.02 vs 47.02 (~0%), net glucose depleted 31.6 vs 33.6 units (6.2%); every interface observable
agrees within ~10%. The MM twin additionally runs with NO cobra at all — the surrogate-model
payoff, a mechanism that runs where the original could not. This is surrogate calibration, not yet
mechanism-independence: the 4 MM params
(mm_vmax 4.0, mm_km 0.5, mm_yield 0.024, mm_overflow 1.4) were TUNED to preserve the interaction
variables (4 knobs fit to 4 observables — exactly determined) — the claim is "a tuned surrogate
matches the coarse-grained relation", not identical internals, and not a derivation of MM from the
dFBA solution.

HELD-OUT TEST NOW RUN (peer-review M2) — the named next step is done, and re-levels this finding
honestly on both sides. With the 4 MM params FROZEN at their tuned values, dFBA vs MM were compared
on conditions neither was tuned on (tests/test_substitutability_heldout.py). Inside the calibrated
glucose-limited, fixed-O2 regime the substitution is MECHANISM-INDEPENDENT, not just a fit — a
held-out initial glucose field (flat 3.0, not the tuned 0.3→3.0 gradient) agrees within 11.9% on
every observable, and a 2x-longer run (40 ticks) within 12.5%. But the lumped MM box carries NO
oxygen variable, and that is its blind spot — on a held-out O2 cap (dFBA 2.5→5.0) dFBA nearly
quadruples its biomass/volume while the O2-blind MM twin is unchanged, so agreement COLLAPSES to
~74%. The honest re-level — mechanism-independence WITHIN the calibrated regime (held-out within
~13% on the glucose/time axes), surrogate calibration only ACROSS the O2 axis the MM box has no
variable for. Degrees of freedom — 4 free MM params vs 4 interface observables (exactly determined),
so the tuned fit was guaranteed a priori; the in-regime held-out agreement is the load-bearing
evidence, and the O2-axis collapse is the load-bearing limitation.

nodes.statement: STEADY-STATE REGIME (M7d, peer review) — the flagship is a pure transient (no source terms), so every flagship number is a transient reading, never a source/sink equilibrium, and the study itself flags this as a limitation. Adding three cell-independent terms behind the same `CpmCellField` ports — a first-order glucose source (grid-wide relaxation toward a setpoint), a first-order acetate decay sink, and a logistic biomass carrying capacity — turns the composite into a chemostat-like regime that reaches a VERIFIED flux steady state. Confirmed — over the final 10 of 120 ticks the per-tick relative change of biomass (0.0015%), field glucose (0.0001%), and field acetate (0.014%) all fall below the 0.1% steady-state tolerance, with standing values biomass ~0.500, CPM volume ~147 px, local glucose ~1.356, field glucose ~5372 (uptake balanced by source), field acetate ~31.5 (secretion balanced by decay); the cell is alive and metabolizing at the fixed point. Note — a biomass dilution term alone gives NO interior fixed point in this coupling (per-pixel uptake scales with biomass/footprint-area, so local glucose equilibrates biomass-independently and mu never falls to a dilution rate); the logistic carrying capacity is what forces every flux to a steady state. This demonstrates the source/sink-equilibrium regime the flagship deferred.

nodes.statement: CADENCE CONVERGENCE (M7d, peer review) — the flagship's operator-split CPM<->dFBA<->diffusion loop runs at coupling cadence 1, and only the PDE substeps are CFL-guarded. Halving then quartering the coupling cadence and measuring the drift in the four gated observables between the two finest levels gives an HONEST two-sided result. instant. Building the ledger caught and fixed a real double-count (a pre-fix logic shed 68
particles over only 62 distinct pixels, re-shedding 6 re-vacated pixels); the fixed shedding
guards against re-shedding any pixel.

nodes.statement: MECHANISM-LEVEL EMERGE UPGRADE (v2, ProtocellV2, answering peer-review M4). Removing the global binary_fill_holes observer from the update and making production depend on a LOCAL interior precursor (k_prod*phi*p*(1-phi/phi_max); the observer survives only as a passive enclosed_area readout, asserted structurally absent from the update) yields GENUINELY EMERGENT closure-dependence. The membrane secretes precursor and is a barrier to it, so a CLOSED ring confines its self-secreted precursor (interior precursor pools ~0 -> ~72 by step 1000) and SUSTAINS topological closure ~2451 internal steps (persists == 1.0, enclosed_area ~293 px at 1000 steps, collapse_tick == -1.0) -- metastable, the same order as v1's window but with no global observer in the loop. The mechanistic single-variable precursor knockout s_p=0 collapses at ~step 95 (~26x faster), as does k_prod=0. And the puncture is now a REAL LOCAL PREDICTION -- zeroing a 60-degree wedge makes interior precursor bleed out through the gap and the wedge membrane starve locally (wedge mass ~2 vs ~79 intact) with no self-heal. EMERGE is therefore upgraded from authored-closure to genuinely-emergent local-mechanism closure. The plateau remains metastable (finite closed budget); an open-system driven version is the remaining next step.

nodes.statement: Sibling cells coupled through the shared glucose field grow at different local rates as the colony crowds -- a cell on the fed rim out-competes one boxed into a depleting interior -- so division timing desynchronizes rather than staying locked to clean powers of two. This is exactly the paper's own description of what happens right after division: "these systems remain coupled through shared environmental state, so their interfaces are not independent ... enabling both coordination and divergence" (§Growth and division). It is the first emergent multicellular heterogeneity this investigation demonstrates, not a nuisance the staircase merely survives. Confirmed: the n_cells staircase departs from powers of two from tick 21 onward (5, then 11, 14, 18), and by the final sampled tick, live cells span all 5 generations (0 through 4) simultaneously in the same 18-cell colony.

nodes.statement: DEVELOPMENT holds spatially: a growing CPM colony on a shared depleting glucose field forms EMERGENT core-vs-rim physiological heterogeneity -- the radial rim-core glucose ratio (`rim_core_ratio`) rises from its 1.0 floor (few cells, no readable gradient) to a clear band above 1.0 by the end of a 45-tick run, the core measurably more depleted than the rim. Now an ENSEMBLE reading across N=30 seeds: mean 1.283 (sd 0.159, range [1.062, 1.815]; flagship seed 3 ends 1.445), with the per-cell core/rim local-glucose split recorded as the scatter behind the scalar -- every seed clears the no-gradient floor. Each cell's individual glucose interface becomes embedded in a COLLECTIVE interface defined by the shared field (the paper's §Development and evolution section, Fig 10c-d). Nothing imposes the structure -- it is the same shared-field mass-balance that drove study 8's division desync, read radially (stewart2008/flemming2016 biofilm physiological heterogeneity).

nodes.statement: EVOLUTION holds spatially, and at N=30 seeds SELECTION is a STATISTICALLY SIGNIFICANT driver of the directional trait shift -- no longer only "consistent with". A Mann-Whitney U rank test on the per-seed mean-`vmax` deltas (selection-ON vs no-selection) is significant (U=685, p=5.3e-4, rank-biserial r=+0.52, CLES 0.76 -- a random selection-ON seed exceeds a random no-selection seed 76% of the time), and the drift-null check rejects neutral drift (Wilcoxon of the selection-ON deltas above the no-selection median, p=1.2e-5). Selection-ON: mean delta +0.233 (sd 0.296, up 22/30). NO-MUTATION control (`mutate: false`, BOOLEAN): mean stays EXACTLY the founder 1.500, var 0, in every seed (0/30 -- static) -- no raw material. NO-SELECTION control (`selection: false`): the trait mutates (var > 0) but the mean drifts UNDIRECTED near zero (mean -0.026, up 13/30) -- the neutral-drift envelope. The directional up-shift is present only when the trait feeds fitness AND is distinguishable from drift at p<0.001, so the dual control now ESTABLISHES selection (not mutation, not drift) as the cause; the effect is medium and the shift modest (+0.23 mean over ~4 generations, one-third of selection-ON seeds still drift down), bounded by the ~gen 4-6 crowding window. The gate is re-leveled onto this ensemble statistic, off the flagship seed 3.

nodes.statement: The MECHANISM by which selection would act is concrete and its wiring verified: differential division on the shared depleting field. The heritable trait `vmax` IS the cell's own dFBA glucose-uptake parameter, so a higher-vmax cell draws more glucose, grows faster, crosses `vol_threshold` sooner, divides more, and its trait proliferates. The trait rides study 8's verified creation-order parent<->daughter pairing (the same one used for biomass/lineage) with the daughter inheriting the parent's trait plus a Gaussian mutation -- confirmed correct across 69 division events (99% within 3 sigma). The trait shift and the larger selected colonies are the SAME proposed mechanism (selection through division rate), not two independent findings.
